# ONE Wellness

> Private in-home personal training in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and one-to-one online
> coaching worldwide. Coached in person by Aaron and Bianca Cook, Olympic medallists
> and world champions in taekwondo.

ONE Wellness is a private coaching practice in Riyadh. There is no studio and no
membership. Sessions take place in the client's own home, or a gym of their choice,
coached personally by Aaron or Bianca Cook. The client list is deliberately short.

Aaron Cook: Junior World Champion, first Olympic Games in Beijing 2008 aged 17,
six-time European Champion, World Grand Prix Champion, World No.1, and Head Taekwondo
Coach at Mahd Sports Academy in Riyadh from 2022.

Bianca Cook: two-time Olympic bronze medallist (Rio 2016, Tokyo 2020), three-time
World Champion, and a former world No.1 in the heavyweight division.

## Services
- Private in-home personal training in Riyadh: training, nutrition and daily habits, built around the client's space, schedule and goals.
- Online coaching worldwide: one-to-one programming, form review and direct access to Aaron or Bianca, delivered through the client's phone.

## Areas served in Riyadh
Diriyah, the Diplomatic Quarter, Hittin, Al Malqa, Al Nakheel, Al Olaya, and the wider city.

## Contact
Enquiries are made through the form at https://www.onewellness-online.com/#introduction and are answered personally
by Aaron or Bianca within two days.
